meta.title: The Community Experience Vault
meta.description: Your story belongs here. Share personal stories, photography, travel diaries and cross-cultural anecdotes that connect Tunisia and Bahrain.

hero.headline: The Community Experience Vault
hero.intro: Have you walked the lanes of Sidi Bou Said or the Pearling Path? Shared tea with a Tunisian family or coffee in a Bahraini majlis? Share the moment. Every photo and every story adds colour and life to this bridge between Tunisia and Bahrain.

items.title: Personal Stories
items.text: A moment, a memory, or a family story connected to Tunisia or Bahrain.
items.prompt: Tell us about a time you felt at home.

items.title: Photography
items.text: Your own photos of places, people, food, crafts and celebrations.
items.prompt: What did you capture that others should see?

items.title: Travel Diaries
items.prompt: Where did you go, what did you taste, who did you meet?

items.title: Cross-Cultural Anecdotes
items.text: Stories that connect the two cultures: a Tunisian in Bahrain, a Bahraini in Tunisia, a shared recipe or a shared word.
items.prompt: What surprised you about how alike we are?

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
items: Share only photos and stories that belong to you.
Be respectful of both cultures and of every visitor.
Do not post private details about other people, such as phone numbers or home addresses.
Do not post offensive, political or commercial content.
Every post is reviewed by the moderation team before it appears.
Posts can be removed at any time if they do not follow these guidelines.
